fields.value: Seven sharp positive spikes with small negative returns and broader later humps have unequal spacing on a soft raster. Tiny positive or negative precomplex candidates vary in visibility and separability; their atrial identity is unresolved, and numeric PR remains held. QRS duration has an unvalidated conditional estimate for selected complexes, whose envelope does not determine a width class. Candidate-shape differences do not establish a changing atrial source.
